"Kabhi mat haar; kabhi surrender mat kar."
"Agar khud par believe hai, toh sab possible."
"Believe karo ya na karo—right tum hi ho."
"Agar fly nahi kar sakte, toh run."
Fail hone se mat daro.
Bade sapne dekho aur fail hone ka courage rakho.
"Itne good bano, log ignore na kar sake."
Tumhara waqt kam hai, ise barbad mat karo.
Self-belief action ka fuel hai.
Aksar yeh namumkin lagta hai, jab tak ho na jaye.
